evidence: Modifies `src/torcontrol.cpp` and `src/torcontrol.h`, which implement the Tor integration covered by P2P.
rationale: Suppresses a recurring log-spam regression introduced in v32 that emits 18 warning and info lines per hour on default nodes without Tor running. It also adds an informational log when an established onion service unexpectedly disconnects. This is a worthwhile quality-of-life fix for node operator logs without impacting P2P network reliability or transport behavior.
